definitions.reference: Exact saved REFERENCE_OPEN; missing/expired unpriced kept but metrics null. No substitution with Selector price.
definitions.time: opportunityTimestamp; saved referenceTimestamp must equal emission time for this population, otherwise stop
definitions.returns: Gross close/reference minus1 percent, exact elapsed wall-clock endpoint; complete contiguous5m bars inside same morning/afternoon segment required. No cost/fill/EXIT inference.
definitions.primary: STRICT30: six contiguous completed5m bars, same prior strict30 definition
definitions.secondary: SAME_SESSION: all remaining expected regular5m bars; observed extrema explicitly incomplete if any missing; known hits true, known negatives only if entire window complete, else unknown. Lunch structurally excluded from bars, elapsed minutes includes lunch.
definitions.ohlc: Parent accepted5m OHLC may have fewer than5 observed underlying minutes. No new provider/minute data. Record fullObservedMinute coverage separately.
definitions.breadth: Unique symbol within actual emission timestamp. Fixed original candidate count1..5 even for top3 exclusion sensitivity. Primary complete-case winner distributions plus all-timestamp true-winner lower bounds and unknown-as-possible-winner upper bounds.
definitions.timeToHit: First observed HIGH touch interval [bar start,bar end] in elapsed minutes. Only paths without preceding missing expected bars yield identified-first-hit time quantiles; others separate. Never assume HIGH/LOW ordering.
definitions.rank: Frozen Selector anchor newEligibleRank and savedV1Score, even for later DIP; descriptive only. No Entry score invented.
definitions.robustness: 4 chronological blocks of19 sessions; top3 by full opportunity frequency fixed before label aggregation; ties symbol ascending.

verdict.common: For original4/5 groups pooled, SAME_SESSION all-timestamp lower-bound P(>=2 +3) >=20% AND P(>=2 +5)>=10%, n>=100; same gates in>=3/4 chronological blocks and after fixed top3 exclusion (original denominators retained). Descriptive definition of common, not profitability.
verdict.dilution: Within each source INITIAL/DIP with >=30 strict30 complete events per low(1..3)/high(4..5) arm: high-minus-low reach <=-10pp at+3 AND <=-5pp at+5. Both sources and>=3/4 overall blocks must satisfy; no post-hoc cutpoints.
verdict.sufficient: If common/dilution not met: original4/5 SAME_SESSION lower-bound P(>=2 +3)>=10% AND P(>=2 +5)>=5%, n>=100; same conditions >=3/4 blocks and after top3 exclusion. Means evidence of plural opportunities, not investment utility or validation.
verdict.weak: Not assignable without a pre-existing economically justified utility/quality benchmark; do not invent one from outcomes.
verdict.closure: REOPEN_JUSTIFIED only for robust dilution; otherwise FREEZE_MAINTAIN. INCONCLUSIVE preserves freeze by no-change default, not proven adequacy.
verdict.outcomeExposed: Prior aggregate strict30/session reaches already exposed; these descriptive verdict cutoffs are not independent performance acceptance gates.
